name: prov-work
description: Knowledge and document architecture analysis for ProvenMap Portal. Analyzes a document/knowledge set — specs, RFCs, policies, design docs, wikis — into a graph of concepts, documents, decisions, and their relationships, and syncs to ProvenMap for collaborative knowledge boards. Tuned for knowledge-work surfaces — Claude Cowork and Codex for Work. Supports server-defined insight analysis skills.
